input.title: DTCC highlights final steps for Treasury clearing mandate
input.summary: DTCC published guidance highlighting final implementation steps for the U.S. Treasury clearing mandate. This appears to relate to the ongoing compliance milestones already recorded under the SEC's extended Treasury clearing deadlines.
evidence_quotes: DTCC highlights final implementation steps for U.S. Treasury clearing mandate
